Go's HTTP client asks for gzip and decodes it; today's core also offers deflate, br and zstd.

The Claude extension sends an API key in x-api-key, as Anthropic's API defines it; today's core sends it as a bearer token whenever the base URL is not api.anthropic.com (it uses x-api-key only there).

The body has a 1h cache breakpoint after a 5-minute one. Today's core turns it into a 5-minute one (it removes the ttl), so the body needs no extended cache beta. This core keeps the client's 1h ttl, so it sends the beta that ttl needs; the rule for the TTL order comes in a later PR.
